The ticket says: Thomasen Schmidt.

Now I understand. Thomasen died in a train accident. Because he reached for the thermos cup.
The mirror is whole again. How is that possible?

The strangers face in the mirror. Wait, no, it's my face. I am Thomasen Schmidt. I died because I reached for the thermos cup. I was dead. I was it the whole time. I just couldn't remember. Or maybe I didn't want to anymore.
Now I am ready. I can let go now.
